sentences: I select a serif typeface for the body text because its letterforms have consistent stroke contrast and bracketed serifs.
I set the point size of the main text to eleven points and check the printed sample against the original specification.
I measure the vertical distance from one baseline to the next and adjust the leading until the text block has an even density.
I examine the space between the capital A and the lowercase v and add a kerning pair to reduce the gap.
I apply uniform letter-spacing to the uppercase heading so that the characters are not too close together.
I count the number of characters per line in the body text and aim for a measure between forty-five and seventy-five characters.
I set the paragraph alignment to justified and then check for uneven word spacing along the right margin.
I assign a larger point size and bold weight to the section headings to distinguish them from the body text.
I compare the stroke thickness of the title and the body text to ensure a clear contrast in typographic color.
I pair a geometric sans-serif for the headings with a humanist serif for the body text and review the combination.
I align the baselines of all text columns to a common grid so that lines across the spread match horizontally.
I measure the height of the lowercase x in the chosen typeface and compare it to the cap height of the same font.
I check the cap height of the uppercase letters to determine how much space they occupy above the baseline.
I note the length of the ascenders and descenders in the font to avoid clipping when setting tight leading.
I enable standard ligatures in the layout so that combinations like fi and fl are replaced by single glyphs.
I apply small caps formatting to the acronyms in the text so they match the lowercase height of the surrounding words.
I use italic style for the book titles in the bibliography and verify that the slant is consistent across the font.
I set the key terms in bold weight to make them stand out from the regular text without changing the point size.
I adjust the font weight from regular to medium for the subheadings to create a subtle shift in emphasis.
I choose a condensed width for the table headers to fit more characters per line without reducing the point size.
